dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge spline with a deep falcate curvature originating from the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Shallow angular ascent relative to the longitudinal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gradual, low-convexity radius across the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak profile with limited horizontal extension from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse interior angle at the transition between the melon slope and the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights and high-contrast light diffusion across the mid-dorsal region; visibility of the horizontal tail fluke and a single ventral pectoral fin.
